[FACT] User is seeking a promotion to senior web developer at their work.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A brag document is a document that highlights your achievements, skills, and experience to showcase your value to a potential employer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To write a brag document for getting promoted to senior web developer, focus on your experience and skills as a web developer, as well as notable projects or accomplishments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Start by making a list of your relevant experience, skills, and accomplishments, including years of experience, certifications, degrees, and notable projects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Organize your information into sections that highlight your strengths and skills as a web developer, such as front-end development, back-end development, and project management or team leadership.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use specific examples and anecdotes to illustrate your skills and accomplishments, such as describing a project where you used a programming language to solve a problem or improve website performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Keep your language positive and enthusiastic; avoid negative language or self-deprecating comments in your brag document.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proofread your document carefully to ensure it is free of typos and errors, as a well-written brag document makes a stronger impression.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By following these tips, you can create a brag document that will help you get promoted to senior web developer at your current job.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Good luck!
